name: new_v2_manus_reduced_spatial_speed_session_v1
features: Original LocalDetailFamily F0 uses only source-window difference thresholds. Independent new-v2 F2a is fixed-0.05 centered trace covariance; F3c is circular-lag covariance without half-window drift at 40 samples. F0v2 requires source Rest and is inapplicable because MANUS has six active classes and no Rest.
classifier: source-trial StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924
aggregation: mean of at most eight disjoint 200 ms windows per native recording
selection: maximize pooled validation Session2 macro-F1, break ties by lower pooled log loss; Session3 is descriptive and never selects arms
scope: Same six users across three sessions, six finger flexion-extension classes, public device; speed and session changes are confounded. Reduced bank is separate from the F0v2 robustness envelope, and final session was previously inspected in this project. No own-device or live claim.
